gitCommit.body:
feat(results): cross-tier hand-order — drag/move items across loved↔onward (9v1f.1) (#315)

The draft-result hand-order list now spans both tiers as ONE ordered sequence with
a real sentinel "Onward" divider. Zone is derived purely from position relative to
the sentinel (manualRank and zone can't disagree — monotonic by construction), and
a move across it writes manualBucket alongside manualRank in the same bulk PATCH.

- Schema (ReorderResultItemsSchema): each order entry carries a required-nullable
  manualBucket (full overlay — a null clears a stale override; R4).
- Service (reorderResultItems): writes manualBucket ?? null per row in-tx.
- RerankPanel: sentinel-divider model — cross-boundary move (keyboard + drag),
  empty-zone reachable, AT-perceivable divider + per-row zone label (WCAG 1.3.1),
  destination-naming announcement.
- page: rerankRows span [...loved, ...onward]; pass lovedCount + computedBucket.
- Tests: RerankPanel cross-tier (promote/demote/empty-zone/drag/a11y); DB
  integration (manualBucket write + stale-clear + required-field 400); e2e
  within+cross-tier journey; page test updated to the both-tiers list.

Design + adversarial review (R1–R4 folded): docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-11-epicS-cross-tier-handorder-design.md
